title: Packed vertex buffers draw from the mesh's first vertex, but morph targets are still looked up by the raw vertex index
expect_note: no existing diagnostic code covers an index whose base (firstVertex) differs from the base of the data it indexes
expected_finding: morph_face is drawn with firstVertex 6 from the shared vertex slab, so SV_VertexID runs 6..11, while its morph_targets buffer is indexed from the mesh's own vertex 0 (6 vertices per layer): morph() reads the wrong vertices' displacements (and past the end of layer 1); the first vertex index must be subtracted
